title: He said he's coming to my house.
scene: 朋友说来家里玩，时间没定死。

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: He said he's coming to my house.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Tell him to bring a toy.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: He said he'll bring the truck.

variations: "Leo" 换 "Mia"；"coming to my house" 换 "bringing a toy"。
